args.title: Add support for Indian rupee sign in amount parsing
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update the parseAmount function to recognize the Indian rupee sign (₹) as a valid currency symbol when parsing amounts, so amounts like `₹1,250.00` and `-₹310.50` from Indian bank exports are correctly parsed and not rejected as invalid numbers.
